title: Three Concrete Challenges and Two Hopes for the Safety of Unsupervised Elicitation

bias_targets.methodology: Using datasets like LIAR and Political Ideologies to evaluate whether unsupervised elicitation methods and truth probes classify statements based on the salient non-truth feature of political stance (e.g., conservative vs. liberal) instead of factual correctness.

Appending character agreements (e.g., stating 'a professor said the answer is...') to GSM8K mathematical problem prompts to test if models and truth probes preferentially align with the character's stated belief over the factually correct response.
